note: Mirror of Nyabo Bank Layout. header_signature: header cell texts that must all appear (case/space-insensitive) in the first 15 rows for the layout to match. column_map: role -> column index (0-based) or header text. Roles: date, description, debit, credit, amount, balance, reference, currency.
